## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Māgaṇḍiyasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 9) is the ninth chapter of the *Mahāniddesa*, an early canonical commentary preserved within the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya. Translated as the *Exposition of the Discourse to Māgaṇḍiya*, the text provides an extensive, verse-by-verse doctrinal and lexical exegesis of the *Māgaṇḍiya Sutta* (Snp 4.9) from the *Aṭṭhakavagga* of the *Sutta Nipāta* [DharmaNexus].

 Substantial shared material is also found in canonical collections such as the *Khandha Saṁyutta* (SN 22) and the *Dasakanipāta* (AN 10) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignments, DharmaNexus detects matches with Chinese Āgama translations (e.g., the *Madhyama Āgama*, T 26, and *Saṃyuktāgama*, T 99 and T 100), Sanskrit works such as the *Arthaviniścayasūtra* and Śāntideva's *Śikṣāsamuccaya*, and Tibetan canonical translations including the *Vinayavastu* (D 1) and scholastic treatises such as the *Abhidharmakośabhāṣya* (D 4090) and *Madhyāntavibhāgaṭīkā* (D 4032) [DharmaNexus].
